visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men are standing in a kitchen-living area. One man has a black t-shirt, facial hair, and visible tattoos on his arms; the other wears a cream-colored t-shirt and has sunglasses on his head. They are talking and gesturing toward the camera. The background shows light brown wooden cabinetry and white walls with exposed wiring. (2) A young man in a white polo shirt uses a long metallic pole to tap and inspect the ceiling of an empty white room with wooden floors. (3) The camera pans to show a worker measuring the height of a concrete beam in the same room using a measuring tape. (4) A man in a blue uniform is on a balcony, checking the tiles on the wall with a small tool. In the background, city buildings are visible through glass railings. (5) A technician in a blue uniform and black cap stands in front of an open electrical panel, recording data on a clipboard. (6) Back to the two original men in the kitchen area, they are laughing and pointing at various parts of the room. (7) A woman in a white jacket and a man walk through an empty hallway into a room with large windows showing a city skyline. (8) Close-up on a bathroom with grey tiles, a white sink, and a mirror covered in plastic film. (9) The man with tattoos stands alone in the kitchen area, speaking directly to the camera with various hand expressions, eventually folding his hands in a pleading gesture.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Field Inspection -> Dialogue on Renovation Concepts -> CTA for Sponsorship.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document the professional house inspection of influencer Hot Dog King's new apartment while demonstrating the services of '35房屋檢驗' and soliciting future brand collaborations for home furnishings.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: On-screen logo '35房屋檢驗', direct interaction with inspection personnel, and verbal endorsement of the inspection quality.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy vlog format to turn a technical house inspection into entertaining social content. The heavy use of variety-show style text overlays and sound effects is typical of high-engagement short-form video in the Taiwan market.
